scope: local full corpus logical backup and fresh cluster restore; not off-host or target-server RTO acceptance
writers: no operator or HTTP containers running; writer pause maintained through complete bundle
database: separate new cluster and owner; no --clean; durability on
backup_copy: independent regular files, no hardlinks/reflinks; fsync and reread hashes
table_oracle: binary COPY all columns, unordered per-row SHA256 multiset sum modulo 2^256 plus XOR and row count; built-in type encodings, not public migration digest
sequence_oracle: all application sequences last_value/is_called, sequence metadata and ownership
keyring: new private rehearsal keyring shared by source/target HTTP probes; historical user cursors not available
